entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6838023243053666688: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 106985: distance 48.146 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.035), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 48.146 +/- 1.685 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 19.1037 +/- 0.6765 mas (same row, RUWE 6.61), 28.2 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 200.193, -9.578 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6838023243053666688 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 4.893 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 106985: radius 4.893 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 56.761 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.062) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 7167 +/- 206 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 106985: effective temperature 7167 +/- 206 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.051).
